description: Schema for validating GCP function configurations (v2)

functions.description: List of functions to be deployed
functions.errorMessage: 'functions' property must be a non-empty array of function objects

build_config.description: Build configuration settings for the function
build_config.errorMessage: 'build_config' is a required property and must include 'runtime' and 'entry_point'

entry_point.description: Entry point for the function (e.g., main function to execute)
entry_point.errorMessage: 'entry_point' is required and must be a string representing the main function entry point

environment_variables.description: Environment variables for the function, defined as key-value pairs
environment_variables.errorMessage: 'environment_variables' must be an object with key-value pairs if provided or must be omitted

runtime.description: Runtime environment for the function, e.g., python38
runtime.errorMessage: 'runtime' is required and must specify the function's runtime as a string

description.errorMessage: 'description' property must be a string if provided or must be omitted

event_trigger.description: Event trigger for the function. Should be omitted if triggered by an HTTP request
event_trigger.errorMessage: 'event_trigger' property must include 'event_type' and may include 'retry_policy'

event_type.description: Type of event that triggers the function, e.g., 'google.storage.object.finalize'
event_type.errorMessage: 'event_type' is required and must be a string

retry_policy.description: Retry policy for the event trigger, if applicable
retry_policy.errorMessage: 'retry_policy' must be a string if provided or must be omitted

labels.description: Labels for the function, defined as key-value pairs for metadata
labels.errorMessage: 'labels' property must be an object with key-value pairs of strings if provided or must be omitted

name.errorMessage: 'name' is a required property and must be a string representing the function's name

service_config.description: Service configuration settings for the function
service_config.errorMessage: 'service_config' must not be empty if provided or must be omitted

all_traffic_on_latest_revision.description: If true, 100% of traffic is routed to the latest revision
all_traffic_on_latest_revision.errorMessage: 'all_traffic_on_latest_revision' must be a boolean if provided or must be omitted

available_cpu.description: Number of CPUs allocated to the function
available_cpu.errorMessage: 'available_cpu' must be a string if provided or must be omitted

available_memory.description: Memory allocated to the function, e.g., '128Mi' for 128 MB
available_memory.errorMessage: 'available_memory' must be a string specifying memory (e.g., '128Mi') if provided or must be omitted

environment_variables.description: Build environment variables for the function, defined as key-value pairs
environment_variables.errorMessage: 'environment_variables' must be an object with key-value pairs of strings, integers, or booleans if provided or must be omitted

ingress_settings.description: Ingress settings to control traffic access to the function
ingress_settings.errorMessage: 'ingress_settings' must be one of 'ALLOW_ALL', 'ALLOW_INTERNAL_ONLY' or 'ALLOW_INTERNAL_AND_GCLB' if provided or must be omitted

max_instance_count.description: Maximum number of instances allowed for the function
max_instance_count.errorMessage: 'max_instance_count' must be an integer if provided or must be omitted

max_instance_request_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests allowed per instance

min_instance_count.description: Minimum number of instances to keep warm for the function
min_instance_count.errorMessage: 'min_instance_count' must be an integer if provided or must be omitted

secret_environment_variables.description: Secret environment variables for the function, defined as an array of secrets
secret_environment_variables.errorMessage: 'secret_environment_variables' must be a non-empty array of objects if provided or must be omitted

items.errorMessage: Each object in 'secret_environment_variables' must include 'key', 'secret', and 'version'

key.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the secret
key.errorMessage: 'key' 'secret_environment_variables' is required and must be a string

secret.description: Name of the secret resource to retrieve
secret.errorMessage: 'secret' 'secret_environment_variables' is required and must be a string

version.description: Version of the secret to use, e.g., 'latest' or a numeric version string
version.errorMessage: 'version' is required and must be either 'latest' or a numeric string

timeout_seconds.description: Execution timeout for the function in seconds
timeout_seconds.errorMessage: 'timeout_seconds' must be an integer if provided or must be omitted

vpc_connector.description: VPC connector to use, if applicable
vpc_connector.errorMessage: 'vpc_connector' must be a string if provided or must be omitted

vpc_connector_egress_settings.description: Egress settings for the VPC connector
vpc_connector_egress_settings.errorMessage: 'vpc_connector_egress_settings' must be one of 'VPC_CONNECTOR_EGRESS_SETTINGS_UNSPECIFIED', 'PRIVATE_RANGES_ONLY' or 'ALL_TRAFFIC' if provided or must be omitted

source_folder.description: Relative path to the folder containing function code
source_folder.errorMessage: 'source_folder' is a required property and must be a string specifying the function's source folder

version.description: Version of the function configuration. Must be 2 for this schema
version.errorMessage: 'version' is a required property and must be set to 1 or 2
